english.title: Enter Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnels with insufficient fuel / power to complete journey
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(5) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
